frontmatter.title: Implementation map
frontmatter.description: Crate-level map of the compiler workspace with normative ownership boundaries and feature anchors.

<SpecPageHeader
	ownerName="Piotr Mikstacki"

<SpecSection title="Scope" id="scope">
This area defines the stable map from compiler workspace crates to specification leaves so normative pages can be traced to active implementation modules.
</SpecSection>

<SpecSection title="Feature index" id="feature-index">
Use the tiles below for normative **feature** contracts in this area.
</SpecSection>
